value.rationale: The exceptional six-perfect-matching permutation action of S5 gives a natural topological symmetry question not addressed by ordinary homotopy rank. An explicit strong equivariant retraction determines a ten-dimensional integral lattice module, a complete rational irreducible splitting and every subgroup quotient graph, including contractibility for S5 and A5 but two surviving loops for C5. The invariant is structurally motivated, not an arbitrary small-slice count.
